## [0.21.10](https://github.com/apify/apify-mcp-server/releases/tag/v0.21.10) (2026-11-13)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Log "Invalid event ID format" as a client fault ([#1906](https://github.com/apify/apify-mcp-server/pull/1906)) ([55e4966](https://github.com/apify/apify-mcp-server/commit/55e4966f66deb607b0a81ea64ce28ed0a54f5ae7)) by @jirispilka
- Return a user error for an unknown Actor MCP tool name ([#1910](https://github.com/apify/apify-mcp-server/pull/1910)) ([789e505](https://github.com/apify/apify-mcp-server/commit/789e505d472b5266a7c7d4cec726bdaf8d6e3469)) by @jirispilka
- Keep invalid Actor names out of the logs ([#1902](https://github.com/apify/apify-mcp-server/pull/1902)) ([de21e49](https://github.com/apify/apify-mcp-server/commit/de21e4987f404ef336ab458e726db685b35078da)) by @jirispilka
- Cap search-apify-docs queries at 150 characters ([#1905](https://github.com/apify/apify-mcp-server/pull/1905)) ([33468bc](https://github.com/apify/apify-mcp-server/commit/33468bc00bcb194abd23a726db8e700b2cd3a8e0)) by @jirispilka
